# Point Dume Consulting

> AI that does real work.

Point Dume Consulting builds AI that does real work: account targeting from public records, agents that each run one repeating job, an AI operating layer across a company's systems, and private AI that answers from a company's own documents. Based in Los Angeles. Managing Partner: Alex Kashtan.
